description: Village Interviews at DEF CON 30 showcases village organizers, interactive demos, hardware badges, and community contests across the convention.

talks.title: Aerospace Village Interview
talks.teaser: An interview with Aerospace Village organizers discussing aviation cybersecurity challenges, satellite research, and flight system defense.

talks.title: Red Team Village Interview
talks.teaser: A walkthrough and interview covering offensive operations, adversary emulation workshops, and CTF challenges in the Red Team Village.

talks.title: Girls Hack Village Interview
talks.teaser: Organizers discuss initiatives to foster gender diversity, youth education, and mentorship within the cybersecurity community.

talks.title: Packet Hacking Village Interview

talks.title: Voting Machine Village Interview

talks.title: AppSec Village Interview
